children.name: Arachnitis uniflora Phil.
children.description: Arachnitis uniflora, the sole species in the genus Arachnitis, is a non-photosynthetic plant species in the family Corsiaceae. This species is mycoheterotrophic, and it obtains carbon from mycorrhizal fungi of the family Glomeraceae which are associated to its roots.

children.name: Corsiopsis chinensis D.X.Zhang, R.M.K.Saunders & C.M.Hu
children.description: Corsiopsis is a genus of plants in the Corsiaceae family. It contains only one known species, Corsiopsis chinensis, endemic to Guangdong Province in China.
